proof_body:
by
  intro f U c p q d hU hc hcU hf hpq hl z hz
  have hconn : IsConnected U := ⟨⟨c, hcU⟩, hc⟩
  set w : ℂ := ⟨p, -q⟩ with hw
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 := congrArg Complex.re h
    have h2 := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp [hw] at h1 h2
    rcases hpq with h' | h'
    · exact h' h1
    · exact h' h2
  have h1 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => w * f z) U := (hf.const_mul w).analyticOnNhd hU
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := AnalyticOnNhd.eq_const_of_re_eq_const (c₀ := d) h1 (fun x hx => by
    have := hl x hx
    simp [hw, Complex.mul_re]
    linarith) hU hconn
  have := (hA z hz).trans (hA c hcU).symm
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hw0 this
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ) (p q d : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → c ∈ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → (p ≠ 0 ∨ q ≠ 0) → (∀ z ∈ U, p * (f z).re + q * (f z).im = d) → ∀ z ∈ U, f z = f c
